description: This Java source file defines the class PolicyEnforcerCacheLoader, which implements an asynchronous cache loader for Enforcer objects. It loads policy enforcers by communicating with a shard proxy via an ActorAskCacheLoader, using specific commands and handling responses related to policies.

classes.name: PolicyEnforcerCacheLoader
classes.description: An immutable final class implementing AsyncCacheLoader to load Enforcer objects asynchronously by querying a shard proxy.

methods.name: PolicyEnforcerCacheLoader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache loader with ask timeout, proxy actor, and setting up command and response transformer functions.

methods.name: asyncLoad
methods.description: Loads an Entry<Enforcer> asynchronously for a given key using the delegate ActorAskCacheLoader.

methods.name: handleSudoRetrievePolicyResponse
methods.description: Handles responses from policy retrieval requests, converting responses to Entry<Enforcer> or throwing exceptions based on response type.

methods.name: badPolicyResponse
methods.description: Creates a Supplier that throws an IllegalStateException with a provided message, used for invalid responses.
